authority_layers.meaning: Exact retained packet/candidate/content/claim identities and declared scope; a new hash means a new submission.
Claimed origin only unless separately authenticated; source text/PR merge is insufficient.
Claimed principal namespace and ID, separate from independently proven event identity.
Issuer-trusted role/action/exact scope/period/revocation proof; not inherited from another subsystem.
Bounded method, exact claims/source evidence, findings, counterevidence and unresolved conditions.
Only an exact scoped factual disposition if independent authority/event/source gates are proven.
Separate source-policy/retention/redistribution/service/AI export gates, never granted by factual review.
Independent analytical/performance validation; no advantage, score or recommendation from review.
Separate blocked gameplay semantics/runtime; context review cannot enable it.

future_authorization_requirements: Separate owner authorization for runtime contract and provider/issuer integration.
Independently establish root registry, issuer delegation/action authority, principal identity and authentication assurance/audience policy.
Independently verified event consent/signatures, approved key algorithms and key-to-principal binding; no trusting strings or pasted signatures.
Trusted temporal provenance, explicit effective intervals, revocation/compromise policy and archived event-time receipts.
Permission-bounded source/assessment retention and independently verifiable source provenance.
Immutable append/readback/concurrency/recovery contracts with closed scope, replay protection and externally pinned identities.
Independent security/PM/owner review and adversarial/conformance evidence; a passing test cannot issue authorization.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: New existing-contract packet/candidate IDs, separate submission predecessor link, and new review with prior review IDs.
lineage_cases.current_use: Fresh exact-scope grant and source review needed; original authorization does not automatically extend.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Append scoped contradiction findings with independently admitted source/counterevidence IDs.
lineage_cases.current_use: Quarantine affected claims; no preferred source or majority vote.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Prior event remains recorded; factual status may be challenged.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Append explicitly scoped INVALIDATE_PRIOR_REVIEW or a correcting review with predecessor references.
lineage_cases.current_use: Only an independently authorized correction/history action can affect current use.
lineage_cases.historical_event: No edit or deletion of the earlier body.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Record verified expiry evidence and evaluate trusted event time separately from evaluation time.
lineage_cases.current_use: No new action or current use under expired authority; require fresh scope authorization/revalidation.
lineage_cases.historical_event: An event valid when issued can remain historically valid if proof survives.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Append issuer-authorized grant-revocation event with effective and recorded time separately bound.
lineage_cases.current_use: Block affected current use/new actions; do not rewrite factual disposition.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Earlier verified event can remain historically valid.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Append issuer-authorized compromise/revocation evidence with explicit retrospective interval.
lineage_cases.current_use: Quarantine affected events/claims; independent review of disputed timing/trust required.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Earlier event bytes remain, but validity-at-event-time may be invalid or unresolved.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: New packet and explicit version scope; no inheritance of an earlier version review/grant.
lineage_cases.current_use: Separate source/context and authorization; never join versions by deck label alone.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Old version and its lineage preserved.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Retain both branches and individual event-time proofs; explicit reconciliation can reference both predecessors.
lineage_cases.current_use: CONFLICTING_REVIEWS; no newest timestamp, Git head, vote, confidence or source preference.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Each event can be historically valid without factual agreement.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Same record/event bytes and identity are idempotent; same nonce with different signed payload rejects.
lineage_cases.current_use: A second record needs a new independently verified event; duplicate content proves no corroboration.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Retain provenance without duplicate voting weight.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Reject mismatch against exact original packet/candidate/content/claim identities. A fully rehashed change is a new submission.
lineage_cases.current_use: No old attestation or grant covers the new content by label.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Retain the original identities and all associated decisions.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Retain metadata, hashes and earlier attestation provenance subject to permissions; never reconstruct source by summary.
lineage_cases.current_use: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE; abstain from stronger/current factual use until authorized source verification is possible.
lineage_cases.historical_event: Historical event record may survive, but source proof is not currently reproducible.

lineage_cases.append_only_action: Quarantine missing, cyclic, foreign-scope or incomplete ancestry.
lineage_cases.current_use: MISSING_LINEAGE; do not infer order from hashes/timestamps or silently install a parent.

projection_contract.determinism: Canonical sorted unique record/claim/parent identities, explicit input-set/lineage digests and evaluation time. No wall-clock default, last-write winner, Git order or voting.
projection_contract.historical_and_current: Separate validity-at-event-time from current-use eligibility; expiry/prospective revocation preserves a proven historical event while blocking current use. Retrospective compromise can invalidate the historical authority claim but never erase its event bytes.
inputs: Exact submitted packet/candidate/claim IDs and bytes
Independently approved trust-root and verification-policy snapshots
Explicit independently trusted evaluation time and consumer scope
Separate permission/production evidence if downstream use requires it
ordered_requirements: Require a separately authorized runtime, exact schema/policy/trust-root snapshots and independently trusted evaluation time. With current implementation, stop at authentication not implemented/authorization not established.
Independently admit exact original packets, candidate content, claims and source evidence through their owning contracts; reject substitutions.
Check bounded complete acyclic lineage, corrections across submissions, foreign scope and duplicate record/event/nonce bindings. No timestamps choose a winner.
Verify issuer trust chain, principal authentication, event signature/consent/audience, exact action/role/scope, trusted event time, authorization interval and archived revocation state at the event.
Separately verify current issuer/key/revocation/use authority at explicit evaluation time. Preserve historical-event validity separately from current-use eligibility.
Retain conflicting valid branches and abstain; only separately authorized explicit reconciliation referencing all relevant parents can resolve factual scope.
For each exact claim, expose only conditional factual declaration correspondence supported by independently verified source/date/deck-version evidence. Unavailable source means abstention.

Keep permission/production identity, source-policy clearance, strategy and gameplay gates separate; no requirement status, source permission or execution promotion. Return canonical deterministic reasons and exact input-set/lineage identities, not confidence scores.

provenance_graph.required_gate: Exact bytes, candidate ID, JSON pointer/value digest and declared scope; no new source authentication.
Independent provider/principal and trusted event identity; currently absent.
Independent issuer authority, exact role/action/scope/interval and revocation proof.
Exact source content/identity/date/scope and method; claimed versus independently verified references remain separate.
Exact decision body and claims, independent reviewer action/consent, event-time scope coverage.
Non-circular external event binds domain/body ID/grant/principal/action/scope/nonce; independently verified signature/time required.
Append-only predecessor links; correction across submissions explicit; missing/cyclic/conflicting ancestry blocks use.
Separate historical validity/current authority/current source and permissions; no implicit strategic or gameplay promotion.

threats.fail_closed_rule: Principal strings, Git authors, account names, pasted signatures and self-asserted owner status are claims only.
No owner role is inferred from merged PRs, author text or tests.
Only separately authenticated issuer grants for the exact role/action/scope are eligible.
Packet, candidate, claim, category, requirement, deck/version and action must all match the grant.
Digest equality does not authenticate origin, publication, currency or a source principal.
Factual review cannot grant retention, redistribution, service, AI export or source-policy clearance.
Recompute all bytes/claim selectors and compare externally pinned submission/attestation bindings; a new hash is a new unreviewed submission.
A newly rehashed body cannot reuse an old signature/event; checksum-only consistency is not authentication.
Bind domain, issuer audience, principal, action, full scope, body ID and unique event nonce; never count duplicates as corroboration.
Require complete acyclic bounded ancestry and exact predecessor identities.
Retain both valid chains; no latest timestamp/commit wins.
Separate proof at event time from current eligibility and prospective versus retrospective revocation.
Exact content, source, scope and claim snapshots remain bound; corrected submissions require fresh explicit coverage.
No factual disposition establishes strategy, net mana, payment, legal activation, observed state or executable semantics.
Archived key/issuer chain and trusted time/revocation receipts must remain auditable; unknown trust status blocks use.
Reference-only material cannot substantiate its external claims; an archived hash is insufficient.
No caller-supplied clock or unspecified whole-system scope establishes an effective authorization interval.
Future atomic exclusive append, readback and content-addressed identity checks must prevent overwrite or partly published chains; no writer is implemented here.
